lines.t: My Shepherd, I know You are here with grace to bestow
You show me You’re near when I least expect it
You give me Your mercy when I feel I least deserve it
I draw closer to You because of Your kindness
I forget why I feel unworthy
As I look up at You in wonder
Who are You, Lord, reveal Yourself to me
Who are You, Lord, so close in my time of need
When I am weak, You are still near
Calling me closer, drawing me here
Who are You, Lord, You meet me where I am
Isn't it the need that first pulled me away
The shame that convinced me I shouldn’t stay
I saw my unrighteousness, the war in my soul
The pull of the flesh trying to take control
I assumed my weakness meant distance
That failure would silence your voice
In my weakness, I expected Your distance
But to my surprise, I found You near
I close my eyes, You pull me deeper
To a holy place where flesh fades from view
I look in Your eyes, and my soul is renewed
Who are You, Lord, reveal Yourself to me
Who are You, Lord, so close in my time of need
When I am weak, You are still near
Calling me closer, drawing me here
Who are You, Lord, You meet me where I am
I thought my flesh would cause Your distance
Then I felt Your presence draw me in
Away from the noise, away from the world
A quiet place as I look upon You
You draw me in and say,
“Come sit next to Me at My table.”
Who are You, Lord, reveal Yourself to me
Who are You, Lord, so close in my time of need
When I am weak, You are still near
Calling me closer, drawing me here
Who are You, Lord, You meet me where I am
You are my Father
Closer than I expect
Still You are with me
In the quiet
In the waiting
Just You me
